card.text: The nearest millisecond pulsar: a neutron star 23 km across that turns 174 times a second.

introduction.text: PSR J0437−4715 is a neutron star 157 parsecs away, 1.4 times the Sun's mass in a ball 23 km wide. Its surface is near 250,000 K, with patches over a million.

temperature.title: NICER hot regions
temperature.summary: Hot patches from a fit to the X-ray pulse, on a cooler surface measured in ultraviolet light. Fitted shapes, not an image.
